item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: Ehsanfoton
item.content:encoded:
P

Privacy Policy

We only collect the information we need to process your order and improve your experience.
We share your shipping address with our fulfillment partners to send you your jewelry.
We will never sell your personal data.
You have full control over your data.

When visitors leave comments on the site, we collect the data shown in the comments form and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. A cookie is a small file placed on your device. It allows us to remember your preferences (like login information and cart contents) and analyze site traffic. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our service.

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g., videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor had visited the other website. These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content.

When you make a purchase from Stellux Gallery, we collect personal information from you to fulfill the order. This includes your name, billing address, shipping address, email address, and phone number. We use this information to process your payment, arrange for shipping, and provide you with order confirmations and invoices.

Your security is our top priority. We do not store your credit card details on our servers. All payments are processed through a secure, third-party payment gateway that is fully compliant with the highest industry standards. Your payment information is encrypted and handled securely by our payment processor.

As a gallery of curated designs, some of our pieces are dispatched directly to you from our creative and brand partners. To make this possible, we securely provide them with your shipping details. We hold all our partners to the highest standards to ensure your order and your data are handled with the utmost care.

We use analytics services, such as Google Analytics, to help us understand how visitors use our site. This data is aggregated and anonymized and helps us improve our website and your shopping experience. This may involve sharing a unique identifier with our analytics partners but does not include personal information like your name or email address.

If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.
For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

If you have an account on this site or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.
Where we send your data Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Contact us at support@stelluxgallery.com for questions.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: Ehsanfoton
item.content:encoded:
Our Commitment to You

At Stellux Gallery, we want you to be completely in love with your new jewelry. If for any reason you are not satisfied with your purchase, we are here to help with a straightforward refund and returns process.

Returns

Our return policy lasts for 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, unfortunately, we cannot offer you a refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused, in the same condition that you received it, and in its original packaging. To complete your return, please contact us at support@stelluxgallery.com with your order number to receive instructions.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer or address on the shipping label. All returns must be sent to the address we provide upon request.

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment within a certain number of days.

Late or missing refunds (if applicable) If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again. Then contact your credit card company; it may take some time before your refund is officially posted. If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund, please contact us.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, please send us an email at support@stelluxgallery.com and include a photo of the damaged item.

Gift Cards

Please note that all purchased gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash. Any remaining balance on a gift card can be used for future purchases and does not expire.

Shipping Returns

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping may be deducted from your refund.

We recommend using a trackable shipping service, as we cannot guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need Help?

For any questions related to our returns policy, please don't hesitate to contact us at support@stelluxgallery.com.

About Us

"Welcome to Stellux Gallery, where we celebrate the beauty of curated affordable jewelry. Our world is built on the belief that jewelry is a personal art form, a way to tell your own unique story without saying a word. We are dedicated to providing a handpicked collection of timeless and trendy pieces, each chosen for its ability to inspire confidence and become a cherished part of your everyday style."

O

Our Mission: To Deliver Beautiful, Curated Affordable Jewelry

"Our mission is to inspire confidence through beauty. We believe everyone deserves to shine, and our collection is a tribute to that belief. Each piece is selected to be a versatile and celebrated part of your journey, helping you express your individuality with grace and style. We are committed to making you feel beautiful, every single day."

H

H

Hi! I'm Amy.


"My journey with Stellux Gallery began with a lifelong passion for design and the timeless allure of jewelry. For years, I searched for pieces that were both beautiful and accessible, but often found a gap between fast-fashion trinkets and prohibitively expensive luxury brands. I believed there had to be a better way—a space where quality craftsmanship and beautiful design could coexist with an affordable price tag.

That belief is the cornerstone of Stellux Gallery. This isn’t just a store; it’s the realization of a dream to create a space where you can discover those perfect, inspiring pieces that resonate with your unique style. My goal is to handpick every item, ensuring it meets our high standards for quality and design, so you can build a collection of curated affordable jewelry that you’ll treasure for years to come."

W

What Makes Stellux Gallery Different?

"In a world of endless choice, we stand apart by focusing on what truly matters: quality, design, and you. Our philosophy is simple but powerful.
Handpicked Curation, Not Mass Production: We don't believe in overwhelming you with thousands of generic items. Instead, I personally select each piece in our collection. This curation process ensures that every necklace, ring, and earring has something special to offer, whether it's a timeless design or a modern twist on a classic. This is the heart of our curated affordable jewelry promise.
Quality Materials You Can Live In: We believe your favorite jewelry should be worn, not just saved for special occasions. That's why we prioritize durable, high-quality materials like 316L stainless steel with advanced PVD plating, which is waterproof and tarnish-resistant. To learn more about this modern technique, you can read about it from a trusted source like the [External Link Suggestion ->] [GIA or a materials science institute].
A Focus on Your Story: We see jewelry as a chapter in your life's story. Whether it's a gift to celebrate a milestone, a ring that symbolizes a promise, or a necklace that simply makes you feel powerful, our pieces are designed to become a part of your journey."

O

Our Journey and Yours

The story of Stellux Gallery is constantly evolving, shaped by the people who wear our jewelry. The images in our gallery capture moments of joy, confidence, and elegance—the very feelings we hope to inspire in you. From delicate pieces perfect for everyday wear to bold statements for special nights out, our collection is designed to accompany you through every chapter.

We invite you to explore our collections and find the pieces that speak to you. We are honored to be a small part of your story. Browse our [Internal Link Suggestion ->] [bestsellers] to see what our community is loving right now.

item.title: 5 Meaningful Jewelry Gift Ideas (Beyond the Obvious)
item.dc:creator: Ehsanfoton
item.content:encoded:
Finding the perfect gift is an art form—it's about finding something that truly speaks to the heart. While any piece of jewelry is special, some carry a deeper, more personal meaning. In this guide, we explore five thoughtful jewelry gift ideas that go beyond the ordinary, helping you choose a present that will be treasured for a lifetime.

1. Birthstone Jewelry

A classic for a reason, gifting a piece with their birthstone is incredibly personal. It shows thoughtfulness and connects the jewelry directly to their identity. It’s a colorful and meaningful way to celebrate them.

2. Initial & Name Necklaces

Personalized jewelry is always a winner. An elegant necklace with their initial, or the initial of a loved one, is a subtle and stylish gift they can wear every day. It’s a modern classic that feels both intimate and fashionable.

3. Lockets

Lockets are timeless treasures that hold secrets and memories close to the heart. Gifting a locket is like giving a beautiful, wearable storybook. It’s a deeply sentimental choice for a close friend, partner, or family member.

4. Celestial-Inspired Pieces

Jewelry featuring moons, stars, and constellations connects the wearer to the magic of the cosmos. It’s a perfect gift for the dreamer in your life, symbolizing guidance, inspiration, and infinite possibility.

Explore our celestial-inspired All Jewelry to find a magical piece.

5. Jewelry Sets

For a truly complete and effortless gift, consider a matching jewelry set. It takes the guesswork out of styling and provides a perfectly coordinated look. It’s a practical yet luxurious option for someone who appreciates polished elegance.

Choosing a gift from the heart is what matters most. We hope this guide inspires you to find that perfect piece in our Gifts For Her.

item.title: The Art of the Necklace Layer—A Beginner’s Guide to Perfect Stacking
item.dc:creator: Ehsanfoton
item.content:encoded:
Learning how to layer necklaces is an art form that transforms your entire look. It’s a simple yet powerful way to express your personal style, add dimension to any outfit, and get more use out of your favorite jewelry pieces. But what makes for a perfect stack? This beginner's guide will walk you through the essential tips and tricks to master the art of necklace layering, turning you into a stacking pro in no time

Why Learning How to Layer Necklaces is a Style Essential

Necklace layering has become a timeless trend for a reason. It allows you to create a unique, curated look that is entirely your own. By combining different chains, pendants, and lengths, you can tell a story, highlight a beautiful neckline, or simply add a touch of sophisticated glamour to a plain t-shirt or an elegant dress. It’s the ultimate form of jewelry self-expression.

Step One: Start With a Focal Point

Every layered look needs a hero piece—something that draws the eye. This could be a gemstone pendant, an oversized charm, or a bold statement chain. Once you have your focal point, layer simpler, shorter, or longer pieces around it to create a balanced look.

Three Golden Rules: Start with the Basics

The foundation of knowing how to layer necklaces properly relies on a few core principles. Start by selecting three to four necklaces of varying lengths. A good rule of thumb is to have at least a 2-inch (5cm) gap between each chain to prevent tangling and allow each piece to shine. A common combination is a choker (14-16 inches), a pendant necklace (18 inches), and a longer chain (20-24 inches).

Choosing Your Necklaces: The Core Components

To create a visually balanced and interesting stack, think of your necklaces in three distinct roles. Having one of each creates a foolproof formula for success.

The Texture Piece: This is your longest chain, and its job is to add depth and visual interest. Opt for a chain with a different texture or style, like a paperclip chain, a beaded chain, or a classic rope chain. This final layer completes the look and adds a touch of effortless cool.

The Anchor Chain: This is your shortest piece, often a choker or a delicate chain that sits close to the collarbone. It sets the foundation for the rest of your layers. Simple chains like a snake chain or a fine cable chain work perfectly here.

The Focal Point: This is typically your mid-length necklace and features a pendant, charm, or locket. It’s the centerpiece of your stack and often holds the most personal meaning. A coin pendant or a simple gemstone necklace is a classic choice.

Mixing Materials and Colors

Don't be afraid to mix metals! The old rule of sticking to just gold or silver is long gone. Combining a silver chain with gold pendants can create a modern and dynamic look. The key to successfully mixing metals is to have one dominant metal and use the other as an accent. According to top stylists at Vogue Magazine, this creates a deliberate and chic look rather than an accidental one.

Material pairings to try
  • Gold + Silver → Chic and modern
  • Rose Gold + Pearls → Soft and romantic
  • Silver + Leather → Edgy and contemporary

5 Expert Tips on How to Layer Necklaces Perfectly

  1. Start Simple: Begin with two or three of your favorite delicate chains.
  2. Vary The Weights: Mix a fine, delicate chain with a slightly thicker one.
  3. Add A Pendant: Introduce a necklace with a charm or pendant as your focal point.
  4. Consider A Lariat: A Y-shaped lariat necklace is a perfect third or fourth layer that adds elegant length.
  5. Use a Spacer Clasp: To prevent tangling, consider a necklace layering clasp that keeps your chains perfectly spaced and separated.

Final Thoughts

With these guidelines on how to layer necklaces, you're ready to start experimenting. Browse our necklace collection to find your perfect anchor, focal point, and texture pieces to begin creating your signature stack today.

item.title: Jewelry Care Guide by Stellux Gallery—Keep Your Jewelry Shining Forever
item.dc:creator: Ehsanfoton
item.content:encoded:
Your jewelry is more than just an accessory; it’s a collection of cherished memories and a reflection of your personal style. Learning how to care for jewelry properly is the key to ensuring your favorite pieces—from delicate necklaces to statement rings—remain as brilliant and beautiful as the day you received them. This comprehensive guide from Stellux Gallery will provide you with the essential tips and tricks to protect your investment and keep your collection shining for years to come.

1. Proper Storage: A Key Step in How to Care for Jewelry

Proper storage is your first line of defense against damage and tarnishing. Tossing your jewelry into a drawer is a recipe for scratches, tangled chains, and broken pieces.

  • Keep It Separate: Store each piece of jewelry individually in a soft pouch, a lined jewelry box with compartments, or an anti-tarnish bag. This prevents harder stones from scratching softer metals and stones.
  • Keep It Dry: Store your jewelry in a clean, dry place. Avoid leaving it in the bathroom, where humidity can cause silver to tarnish quickly.
  • Keep It Safe: When traveling, use a dedicated travel jewelry case to protect your pieces from being crushed or damaged in your luggage.

2. Avoiding Common Jewelry Mistakes

Knowing how to care for jewelry also means knowing what not to do. Many everyday activities can harm your precious items.

  • Chemicals Are the Enemy: Hairspray, perfume, lotions, and household cleaners contain chemicals that can dull the finish of your jewelry and damage porous stones like pearls. Always put your jewelry on after applying cosmetics and lotions.
  • Remove Before Activities: Take off your jewelry before swimming (chlorine is harsh), exercising (sweat can cause tarnish), or doing household chores.
  • Be Mindful of Impact: Remove rings before lifting heavy objects to avoid bending the band or scratching the stones.

3. A Gentle Cleaning Routine at Home

While professional cleaning is great, a simple at-home cleaning routine can keep your pieces sparkling between visits. This is a fundamental part of how to care for jewelry.

Rinse and Dry: Rinse the jewelry thoroughly under cool running water. Pat it completely dry with your soft, lint-free cloth before storing.

Gather Your Supplies: You’ll need a small bowl of warm water, a few drops of mild, phosphate-free dish soap, a very soft-bristled toothbrush (a baby toothbrush is perfect), and a soft, lint-free cloth.

Create the Solution: Mix the warm water and dish soap in the bowl to create a gentle, sudsy solution.

Soak and Scrub: Let your jewelry (most gold, platinum, and diamond pieces are safe for this) soak for 15-20 minutes. Then, use the soft toothbrush to gently scrub away any dirt, paying special attention to crevices around settings.

4. Special Care for Gemstones and Pearls

Not all jewelry is created equal. Pearls and certain gemstones require special handling.

  • Pearls: These are very soft and porous. Never soak them. Simply wipe them with a soft, damp cloth after each wear to remove body oils.
  • Emeralds: These beautiful green stones are often treated with oils to enhance their clarity. Avoid ultrasonic cleaners and harsh chemicals, as they can strip these oils.
  • Opals: Opals contain water and can crack if they dry out. Avoid storing them in direct sunlight or in very dry conditions for long periods.

For detailed information on specific gemstones, the GIA's Gem Encyclopedia is an invaluable resource for any jewelry lover.

5. Know When to Seek Professional Maintenance

At least once a year, it's a wise idea to take your most-worn or valuable pieces to a professional jeweler. They can check for loose prongs, worn-out clasps, and provide a deep, professional cleaning that restores the original brilliance of your jewelry.

Conclusion: A Lifetime of Sparkle

Knowing how to care for jewelry is a simple practice that offers a lifetime of rewards. By following these easy steps for cleaning, storage, and maintenance, you can ensure your Stellux Gallery collection remains a source of joy and beauty for years to come. item.title: The Ultimate Guide to Measuring Ring and Bracelet Sizes at Home
item.dc:creator: Ehsanfoton
item.content:encoded:
Finding the perfect ring online is an exciting experience, but it comes with one crucial question: what’s my size? Learning how to measure ring size at home is easier than you think, and getting it right ensures your new piece of jewelry fits perfectly from the moment it arrives. This ultimate guide will walk you through two simple methods to find your accurate ring size, plus tips for measuring for bracelets, so you can shop with complete confidence.

How to Measure Ring Size: Two Easy At-Home Methods

Before you start, remember that your finger size can fluctuate slightly throughout the day. For the most accurate result, it's best to measure your finger at the end of the day when it's at its largest. Avoid measuring when you're cold, as your fingers can be smaller.

Method 1: Using a String or Paper Strip

This is the most common and accessible method for finding your ring size without a professional sizer.

  1. Cut a Strip: Take a piece of string, floss, or a thin strip of paper (about 6 inches long and 1/4 inch wide).
  2. Wrap Your Finger: Wrap the strip snugly around the base of the finger you want to measure. It should be tight enough not to slip off, but loose enough to slide over your knuckle.
  3. Mark the Spot: Using a pen, carefully mark the point where the end of the strip overlaps.
  4. Measure the Length: Unwrap the strip and lay it flat against a ruler. Measure the length from the end of the strip to the mark you made, in millimeters (mm).
  5. Find Your Size: Use the measurement and our International Ring Size Conversion Chart below to find your corresponding ring size..
Method 2: Measuring an Existing Ring

If you already have a ring that fits the intended finger perfectly, you can use it to determine your size.

  1. Choose a Ring: Select a ring that has a similar band width to the one you want to purchase.
  2. Measure the Diameter: Place the ring on a ruler and measure the internal diameter in the center of the ring, from one side to the other.
  3. Convert to Size: Use our conversion chart to match the diameter (in mm) to the correct ring size.

Important Tips for Accurate Measurement

Getting a precise measurement is the most important part of this process. Here are a few extra tips from our jewelry experts on how to measure ring size correctly every time.

  • Measure Multiple Times: For best results, measure your finger three to four times to account for any small fluctuations.
  • Consider Your Knuckle: If your knuckle is significantly larger than the base of your finger, measure both areas and choose a size that falls between the two. You need a ring that can slide over your knuckle but won't be too loose at the base.
  • Think About Band Width: A wider ring band will feel tighter than a delicate, thin band. If you're purchasing a ring with a wide band (6mm or more), we recommend choosing a size that is a half-size larger than your normal measurement.
  • What If I'm Between Sizes? If your measurement falls between two sizes, it's always safer to choose the larger size.
International Ring Size Conversion Chart

Measuring Bracelet Size at Home

Step 1: Measure Your Wrist

Using a flexible measuring tape or a strip of paper, wrap it around your wrist just below the wrist bone, where you would typically wear a bracelet. Make sure it's snug but not too tight. Mark the spot and measure the length. This is your wrist size.

Step 2: Choose the Bracelet Fit

Now, add length to your wrist size based on your desired fit:

  1. Snug Fit: Add 1/4 to 1/2 inch (about 1cm)
  2. Comfort Fit: Add 3/4 to 1 inch (about 2cm)
  3. Loose Fit: Add 1 1/4 inch (about 3cm)

For a more visual guide, you can often find a printable ruler online from a trusted source like a major university's measurement guide or a reputable tools website.

Now that you have mastered how to measure ring size and bracelet size like a pro, you're ready to find your next favorite piece.. Explore the stunning collection at our rings category page and shop with the confidence that you've found the perfect fit.
